name: Marie Sklodowska-Curie Postdoctoral Fellowship - European Fellowship (MSCA PF-EF)
amount: Living allowance, mobility allowance and family/leave/special-needs allowances where applicable, plus research, training and networking costs to the host
other_rules: PhD held (or defended) by the call deadline
up to 8 years of research experience after the PhD (career breaks and non-research time excluded)
host must be in an EU member state or Horizon Europe associated country
must not have lived or worked mainly in the host country for more than 12 months in the 36 months before the deadline
resubmission restricted if the previous year scored below 80%
notes: 2026 call (HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01) ran 9 Apr to 9 Sep 2026; the 2027 call is expected on a similar timeline. Fellowships last 1-2 years. The host organisation submits with the researcher. Proposals scoring 85% or more that are not funded get a Seal of Excellence.
